title: Geometry of the explicit tail-open inverse diagram
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $c$ a limiting cone on $D$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Assume that each stage is quasi-separated and every transition is affine [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $O,W$ be opens of a scheme $X$ with $W\le O$ and $W$ quasi-compact, fix $i_0\in I$, and let $e:D_{i_0}\cong O$. Use the explicit tail-open diagram and cone of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-open-restricted-system], with $g_0=e;O\hookrightarrow X$: the stage at $j\ge i_0$ is $(D(j\to i_0);g_0)^{-1}W$, with the restricted transition maps, and the cone point is $(c_{i_0};g_0)^{-1}W$. This cone is limiting, every stage is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, every transition is affine, and the stage at $i_0$ is isomorphic to $W$.

proof.text: The restricted transition square is cartesian by the equality of inverse-image opens, so affine base-change permanence proves the transition affine. Restrict e and use W ≤ O to identify its inverse-image open with W; compactness transfers across this isomorphism. Affine maps are quasi-compact, so their inverse images of this compact open are compact at every later stage. At the least index the transition is the identity, giving the displayed stage isomorphism.

proof.text: An open subset of a quasi-separated space is quasi-separated: compact opens of the open subspace are compact opens of the ambient space, so their intersection is compact. Apply isQuasiSeparated_iff_quasiSeparatedSpace and IsQuasiSeparated.of_quasiSeparatedSpace to the stage open.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_limit_tail_open_geometry
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (O W : X.Opens) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X)) (hWO : W ≤ O)
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (i₀ : I) (e : D.obj (op i₀) ≅ O.toScheme) :
    let DW := tailOpenDiagram D (e.hom ≫ O.ι) W
    Nonempty (IsLimit (tailOpenCone D c (e.hom ≫ O.ι) W)) ∧
    (∀ j : (Set.Ici i₀)ᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (DW.obj j)) ∧
    (∀ j : (Set.Ici i₀)ᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (DW.obj j)) ∧
    (∀ (j k : (Set.Ici i₀)ᵒᵖ) (f : j ⟶ k), IsAffineHom (DW.map f)) ∧
    Nonempty (DW.obj (op ⟨i₀, le_rfl⟩) ≅ W.toScheme)
